title: Pre-Hardmode Melee
summary: High defense, close-range damage. Beat Skeletron and the Wall of Flesh with heavy hitters and strong armor.

weapons.label: Muramasa — fast early-game sword (found in Gold Chests / Golden Lock Boxes)
Night's Edge — combine Muramasa, Fiery Greatsword, Blade of Grass, and Light's Bane/Blood Butcherer at a Demon/Crimson Altar
Starfury — Sky Crate drop, strong AoE ranged-melee hybrid, good vs Skeletron

accessories.label: Obsidian Shield — no knockback + fire immunity
Cloud in a Bottle — extra jump
Hermes Boots — movement speed
Band of Regeneration — passive healing
Feral Claws — melee speed and knockback
Philosopher's Stone — faster potion cooldown
Shield of Cthulhu (Crimson alt to Obsidian Shield) — dash + no knockback, if farmed

notes: Full loadout: Molten Armor set + Night's Edge (or Starfury for the Skeletron fight) + the 7 accessories above. Craft Molten Armor at a Hellforge from Hellstone Bars + Obsidian. Farm Hellstone using an Obsidian Skin Potion or Obsidian Skull/Horseshoe combo so lava doesn't kill you. Use Ironskin and Regeneration potions for the Wall of Flesh.

title: Pre-Hardmode Ranged
summary: Strong single-target and crowd control from range; ammo economy matters early.

weapons.label: Minishark — cheap, high fire-rate clear weapon (Arms Dealer)
The Bee's Knees — Queen Bee drop, strong bow upgrade
Star Cannon — Sky Crate drop, top-tier pre-Hardmode boss weapon

accessories.label: Obsidian Shield — no knockback + fire immunity
Cloud in a Bottle — extra jump
Hermes Boots — movement speed
Band of Regeneration — passive healing
Magic Quiver — arrow damage/velocity, chance to not consume arrows
Philosopher's Stone — faster potion cooldown

notes: Full loadout: Necro Armor set + Star Cannon (Sky Crate farming) or Minishark for general clearing, plus the 6 accessories above. Necro Armor pieces come from Skeletron (Headgear) and Shadow Orbs/Crimson Hearts (Breastplate, Greaves). Stock Musket Balls or Meteor Shots and keep max distance during the Wall of Flesh fight.

title: Pre-Hardmode Mage
summary: Highest burst potential pre-hardmode but mana-hungry; strongest against Wall of Flesh with Space Gun spam.

weapons.label: Water Bolt — cheap mana, strong early dps (found underground)
Space Gun — infinite ammo, no mana cost with Meteor set bonus
Flamelash — Underworld drop, strong hallway damage vs Wall of Flesh

accessories.label: Obsidian Shield — no knockback + fire immunity
Cloud in a Bottle — extra jump
Hermes Boots — movement speed
Band of Regeneration — passive healing
Mana Flower — auto-drinks mana potions, +magic damage
Nazar — cures Confused debuff, small stat stepping stone toward Celestial Shell

notes: Full loadout: Meteor Armor set + Space Gun as your primary (the set bonus reduces its mana cost to 0, making it free infinite damage), plus the 6 accessories above. Craft Meteor Armor from Meteorite Bars after a Meteorite crash lands. Stock mana potions as backup for Water Bolt/Flamelash bursts.

title: Pre-Hardmode Summoner
summary: Weakest pre-hardmode class but still viable with careful positioning; hybridize with another weapon type.

weapons.label: Slime Staff — reliable early summon (Slime drop)
Optic Staff — Queen Bee drop, strongest pre-Hardmode summon
Minishark — secondary damage source while your summon works (Arms Dealer)

accessories.label: Obsidian Shield — no knockback + fire immunity
Cloud in a Bottle — extra jump
Hermes Boots — movement speed
Band of Regeneration — passive healing
Philosopher's Stone — faster potion cooldown

notes: Full loadout: Bee Armor set + Optic Staff as your main summon, plus the 5 accessories above. Bee Armor and Optic Staff both come from Queen Bee — farm the Bee biome before Skeletron. Summoner is genuinely weak pre-Hardmode; lean on Minishark or another secondary weapon for damage and keep moving during the Wall of Flesh fight since summons don't need line of sight.

title: Early Hardmode Melee
summary: Push through Cobalt → Mythril → Adamantite/Titanium ore tiers to gear up for your first Mechanical Boss.

weapons.label: Cobalt Sword — first Hardmode melee weapon tier
Excalibur — Hallowed Bar sword, strong pre-Mech-Boss upgrade
Adamantite Sword (or Titanium Sword) — goal weapon before your first Mechanical Boss attempt

accessories.label: Ankh Shield — immunity to nearly every debuff + no knockback
Frostspark Boots — movement speed + flight
Warrior Emblem — flat melee damage boost
Titan Glove — melee knockback
Band of Regeneration — passive healing

notes: Full loadout: Adamantite Armor (or Titanium, whichever ore your world generated) + Adamantite/Titanium Sword, plus the 5 accessories above. This is the practical gear ceiling before fighting your first Mechanical Boss — Cobalt/Palladium and Mythril/Orichalcum are just stepping stones through this tier, so don't over-invest time in them. Craft the Ankh Shield from the full Ankh Charm before your Mech Boss attempt. Stick to one metal type per armor tier since set bonuses require a full matching set.

title: Early Hardmode Ranged
summary: Push through Cobalt → Mythril → Adamantite/Titanium ore tiers to gear up for your first Mechanical Boss.

weapons.label: Cobalt Repeater — first Hardmode bow-tier weapon
Shotgun — strong short-range burst (Golden Lock Box)
Adamantite Repeater (or Titanium Repeater) — goal weapon before your first Mechanical Boss attempt

armor.label: Adamantite Headgear (or Titanium Headgear) — ranged-focused helmet piece

accessories.label: Ankh Shield — immunity to nearly every debuff + no knockback
Frostspark Boots — movement speed + flight
Ranger Emblem — flat ranged damage boost
Magic Quiver — arrow damage/velocity, ammo conservation
Band of Regeneration — passive healing

notes: Full loadout: Adamantite Armor (or Titanium) with the ranged Headgear piece + Adamantite/Titanium Repeater, plus the 5 accessories above. Ranged scales cleanly through Hardmode ore tiers — keep upgrading repeaters and buy any craftable guns as soon as you can afford them, then push all the way to Adamantite/Titanium before your first Mech Boss.

title: Early Hardmode Mage
summary: Push through Cobalt → Mythril → Adamantite/Titanium ore tiers to gear up for your first Mechanical Boss; Golden Shower is a standout weapon.

weapons.label: Golden Shower — strong DoT weapon with a defense-reducing debuff, your main goal weapon for this stage
Crystal Storm — Cobalt-tier magic weapon
Rainbow Rod — Corruption alternative to Golden Shower

armor.label: Adamantite Headgear (or Titanium Headgear) — magic-focused hat piece

accessories.label: Ankh Shield — immunity to nearly every debuff + no knockback
Frostspark Boots — movement speed + flight
Sorcerer Emblem — flat magic damage boost
Mana Flower — auto-drinks mana potions, +magic damage
Band of Regeneration — passive healing

notes: Full loadout: Adamantite Armor (or Titanium) with the magic Headgear piece + Golden Shower as your main weapon, plus the 5 accessories above. Golden Shower's defense-reduction debuff makes Mechanical Boss fights noticeably easier for your whole team, not just you. Push all the way to Adamantite/Titanium gear before your first Mech Boss attempt.

title: Early Hardmode Summoner
summary: Summoner comes online hard in Hardmode — Spider Armor and Spider Staff are a huge power spike.

weapons.label: Spider Staff — massive pre-Plantera summon upgrade (Spider biome)
Optic Staff — carries until Spider Staff is farmed
Adamantite Repeater (or Titanium Repeater) — secondary damage source

accessories.label: Ankh Shield — immunity to nearly every debuff + no knockback
Frostspark Boots — movement speed + flight
Summoner Emblem — flat summon damage boost
Necromantic Scroll — extra summon damage
Band of Regeneration — passive healing

notes: Full loadout: Spider Armor set + Spider Staff, plus the 5 accessories above. Spider Armor and Spider Staff both drop in the underground Corruption/Crimson Spider biome — this combo is considered one of the strongest single power spikes in the entire game for summoners, so prioritize farming it as soon as Hardmode starts.

title: Post-Mechanical Bosses → Plantera Melee
summary: Hallowed gear and yoyos carry into Plantera.

weapons.label: True Excalibur — Excalibur + Broken Hero Sword combined at a Mythril/Orichalcum Anvil
Amarok — strong pre-Plantera yoyo (Ice biome)
Flairon — post-Plantera goal weapon (Dungeon + Plantera loop farming)

accessories.label: Ankh Shield — immunity to nearly every debuff + no knockback
Fire Gauntlet — melee speed, knockback, and extra fire damage
Warrior Emblem — flat melee damage boost
Yoyo Bag — extends yoyo range, only useful if using a yoyo
Frostspark Boots — movement speed + flight

notes: Full loadout: Hallowed Armor set + True Excalibur, plus the 5 accessories above. Fight Plantera in the Jungle for Chlorophyte access, then farm Turtle Armor from the Jungle's Turtles once Chlorophyte ore is available as your follow-up armor set.

title: Post-Mechanical Bosses → Plantera Ranged
summary: Hallowed gear and Hardmode guns carry into Plantera.

weapons.label: Uzi — strong Hallowed-tier automatic weapon
Tactical Shotgun — Mechanical Boss drop, top pre-Plantera shotgun
Sniper Rifle — high single-target dps, good vs Plantera

accessories.label: Ankh Shield — immunity to nearly every debuff + no knockback
Ranger Emblem — flat ranged damage boost
Magic Quiver — arrow damage/velocity, ammo conservation
Frostspark Boots — movement speed + flight
Band of Regeneration — passive healing

notes: Full loadout: Hallowed Armor (ranged Headgear) + Sniper Rifle or Tactical Shotgun, plus the 5 accessories above. Sniper Rifle's high single-shot damage handles Plantera's bulb and tanky phases well; keep Tactical Shotgun or Uzi for general clearing. Chlorophyte gear becomes your follow-up after Plantera drops Chlorophyte ore access.

title: Post-Mechanical Bosses → Plantera Mage
summary: Hallowed gear and strong AoE/DoT spells carry into Plantera.

weapons.label: Bat Scepter — strong summon-hybrid magic weapon
Rainbow Rod — long-range piercing projectile, good vs Plantera
Nimbus Rod — passive AoE raincloud, strong crowd control

accessories.label: Ankh Shield — immunity to nearly every debuff + no knockback
Sorcerer Emblem — flat magic damage boost
Mana Flower — auto-drinks mana potions, +magic damage
Frostspark Boots — movement speed + flight
Band of Regeneration — passive healing

notes: Full loadout: Hallowed Armor (magic Headgear) + Rainbow Rod as your main damage dealer, plus the 5 accessories above. Nimbus Rod is excellent for passive damage during the Plantera chase phase since it doesn't require aiming. Chlorophyte gear becomes your follow-up after Plantera drops Chlorophyte ore access.

title: Post-Mechanical Bosses → Plantera Summoner
summary: Hallowed gear and stronger minions carry into Plantera.

weapons.label: Blade Staff — strong pre-Plantera summon (Hallowed biome)
Sanguine Staff — Crimson alternative to Blade Staff
Pygmy Staff — post-Plantera goal summon

accessories.label: Ankh Shield — immunity to nearly every debuff + no knockback
Summoner Emblem — flat summon damage boost
Necromantic Scroll — extra summon damage
Frostspark Boots — movement speed + flight
Band of Regeneration — passive healing

notes: Full loadout: Hallowed Armor set + Blade Staff (or Sanguine Staff), plus the 5 accessories above. Spider Armor is still viable here if you haven't upgraded past it — Hallowed Armor's boost is smaller for summoners than for other classes, so don't feel pressured to rush the swap. Pygmy Staff and Spooky Armor become your follow-up goal after Plantera.

title: Pre-Hardmode Rogue
summary: Thrown weapons carry pre-Hardmode; no dedicated Rogue armor set exists yet, so borrow from other classes for defense.

weapons.label: Throwing Knife — cheap, spammable early clear (Merchant)
Flaming Arrow (thrown as darts pre-1.4.4 style) — swap to Frost/Ichor Arrows as thrown ammo if using an Arrow launcher
Bone Javelin — Dungeon farm, strong armor-piercing early thrown weapon

armor.label: Necro Helmet — borrowed from Ranged, boosts general damage/crit

accessories.label: Obsidian Shield — no knockback + fire immunity
Cloud in a Bottle — extra jump
Hermes Boots — movement speed
Band of Regeneration — passive healing
Philosopher's Stone — faster potion cooldown

notes: Rogue as a formal class with its own stealth mechanic was added in 1.4.4; pre-Hardmode it plays like a thrown-weapon hybrid since dedicated Rogue armor doesn't exist until Hardmode. Borrow Necro Armor for the general damage/crit bonus and lean on Throwing Knives and Bone Javelins for damage. Craft Bone Javelins in bulk from Bones farmed in the Dungeon.

title: Early Hardmode Rogue
summary: The first real Rogue armor set — Stalker's Quiver bonus rewards headshots and stealth strikes.

weapons.label: Frost Daggerfish — strong early Hardmode thrown weapon (Ice biome fishing)
Ichor Trident — applies Ichor debuff to lower enemy defense
Flask of Venom — coats weapons for bonus Venom damage-over-time

accessories.label: Ankh Shield — immunity to nearly every debuff + no knockback
Frostspark Boots — movement speed + flight
Shark Tooth Necklace — flat rogue/melee-adjacent damage boost
Band of Regeneration — passive healing

notes: Full loadout: Stalker's Armor set + Frost Daggerfish or Ichor Trident, plus the accessories above. Stalker's set bonus rewards standing still to build stealth before striking, so play more patiently than Melee. Coat weapons with a venom/ichor flask before big fights for extra sustained damage.

title: Post-Mechanical Bosses → Plantera Rogue
summary: Thrown explosives and Hallowed-tier gear push Rogue's burst damage into Plantera range.

weapons.label: Bouncing Shield — Hardmode dungeon drop, strong piercing thrown weapon
Flask of Cursed Flames — coats weapons for bonus Cursed Flame damage-over-time
Flairon (thrown-adjacent hybrid via bubbles) — strong post-Plantera goal weapon

accessories.label: Ankh Shield — immunity to nearly every debuff + no knockback
Shark Tooth Necklace — flat damage boost
Frostspark Boots — movement speed + flight
Band of Regeneration — passive healing

notes: Full loadout: Stalker's Armor + Bouncing Shield or a cursed-flame-coated thrown weapon, plus the accessories above. Rogue's itemization thins out here — you'll likely still be in Stalker's Armor while other classes are already in Hallowed/Turtle gear, so lean on stealth-strike burst timing against Plantera's bulb rather than raw sustained dps.

title: Post-Plantera → Golem Melee
summary: Chlorophyte and Shroomite-adjacent melee weapons, plus Turtle Armor's counter-damage tank set, carry through the Dungeon and Golem.

weapons.label: Terra Blade — combine True Excalibur + True Night's Edge, top-tier pre-Golem sword
Death Sickle — Mourning Wood drop (Pumpkin Moon), strong piercing projectile sword
Flairon — if not already farmed, top-tier flail from the Dungeon/Plantera loop

accessories.label: Ankh Shield — immunity to nearly every debuff + no knockback
Fire Gauntlet — melee speed, knockback, and extra fire damage
Warrior Emblem — flat melee damage boost
Frostspark Boots — movement speed + flight
Charm of Myths — faster potion cooldown + healing potion boost

notes: Full loadout: Turtle Armor set (Chlorophyte-based, huge defense + damage reflection) + Terra Blade, plus the 5 accessories above. Farm Chlorophyte Ore in the Jungle post-Plantera, then craft Turtle Armor at a Mythril/Orichalcum Anvil. Terra Blade requires both True Excalibur and True Night's Edge — the latter needs a Broken Hero Sword drop from Plantera's Bulb.

title: Post-Plantera → Golem Ranged
summary: Shroomite Armor and Chlorophyte-based guns are the biggest ranged power spike in the game so far.

weapons.label: Chlorophyte Shotbow — homing multi-arrow bow, top-tier pre-Golem ranged weapon
Venus Magnum — Mourning Wood drop (Pumpkin Moon), strong pistol
Chain Gun — Dungeon post-Plantera drop, high dps automatic weapon

accessories.label: Ankh Shield — immunity to nearly every debuff + no knockback
Ranger Emblem — flat ranged damage boost
Magic Quiver — arrow damage/velocity, ammo conservation
Frostspark Boots — movement speed + flight
Charm of Myths — faster potion cooldown + healing potion boost

notes: Full loadout: Shroomite Armor (from Glowing Mushroom biome + Chlorophyte Bars) + Chlorophyte Shotbow, plus the 5 accessories above. Shroomite's set bonus grants huge damage while standing still, so alternate with a mobility accessory swap for boss phases that require dodging. This is widely considered ranged's strongest relative power spike.

title: Post-Plantera → Golem Mage
summary: Spectre Armor's healing-focused set bonus and strong AoE spells carry mage through the Dungeon and Golem.

weapons.label: Crystal Serpent — Hallow fishing crate, piercing bouncing projectile
Golden Shower — still relevant for its defense-debuff utility
Laser Rifle — Dungeon post-Plantera drop, powerful focused beam

armor.label: Spectre Hood — healing set bonus variant

accessories.label: Ankh Shield — immunity to nearly every debuff + no knockback
Sorcerer Emblem — flat magic damage boost
Mana Flower — auto-drinks mana potions, +magic damage
Frostspark Boots — movement speed + flight
Charm of Myths — faster potion cooldown + healing potion boost

notes: Full loadout: Spectre Armor (Hood variant for hybrid damage + healing) + Laser Rifle or Crystal Serpent, plus the 5 accessories above. Craft Spectre gear from Spectre Bars (Hallow Ectoplasm + Souls of Light) at an Ancient Manipulator. Swap to the Mask variant if you want pure damage over the sustain from Hood.

title: Post-Plantera → Golem Summoner
summary: Spooky Armor plus Pygmy Staff/Optic Staff double-summon is the go-to setup through the Dungeon and Golem.

weapons.label: Pygmy Staff — Plantera drop, strong minion
Optic Staff — paired for extra minion slots/damage variety
Xeno Staff (if farmed early via Martian event) — UFO minion upgrade

accessories.label: Ankh Shield — immunity to nearly every debuff + no knockback
Summoner Emblem — flat summon damage boost
Necromantic Scroll — extra summon damage
Frostspark Boots — movement speed + flight
Charm of Myths — faster potion cooldown + healing potion boost

notes: Full loadout: Spooky Armor set + Pygmy Staff, plus the 5 accessories above. Spooky Armor's set bonus boosts minion damage further the longer you avoid taking hits — keep distance and let minions do the work. Craft Spooky Armor from Ectoplasm farmed in the Dungeon post-Plantera.

title: Post-Plantera → Golem Rogue
summary: Thrown weapon variety expands with Dungeon and biome-chest drops through Golem.

weapons.label: Bouncing Shield — strong piercing thrown weapon
Flask of Ichor — coats weapons, lowers enemy defense
The Rotted Fork — Corruption world-evil thrown weapon

accessories.label: Ankh Shield — immunity to nearly every debuff + no knockback
Shark Tooth Necklace — flat damage boost
Frostspark Boots — movement speed + flight
Charm of Myths — faster potion cooldown + healing potion boost

notes: Full loadout: Stalker's Armor + Bouncing Shield, plus the accessories above. Rogue still lacks a dedicated armor upgrade at this stage in most playthroughs — stack damage-over-time flasks (Ichor, Venom, Cursed Flame) to make up for the gap in raw weapon tiers, and prioritize Shark Tooth Necklace for the flat boost.

title: Post-Golem → Moon Lord Melee
summary: Solar Flare Armor and Zenith-tier swords prepare melee for the Lunar Events and Moon Lord.

weapons.label: Terra Blade — still viable, upgrade path toward Meowmere/Star Wrath
Meowmere — Pumpkin Moon wave 15 drop, top-tier meme sword with real damage
Star Wrath — Frost Moon wave 15 drop, strong falling-star sword

accessories.label: Ankh Shield — immunity to nearly every debuff + no knockback
Fire Gauntlet — melee speed, knockback, and extra fire damage
Destroyer Emblem — flat damage boost, upgrade to Avenger Emblem later
Frostspark Boots — movement speed + flight
Charm of Myths — faster potion cooldown + healing potion boost

notes: Full loadout: Solar Flare Armor (from Fragments dropped by the Celestial Pillars) + Meowmere or Star Wrath, plus the 5 accessories above. Solar Flare has the highest base defense of any pre-Moon Lord set and its set bonus rewards aggressive melee play. Farm the Pumpkin/Frost Moon events for the best pre-Moon-Lord weapon drops before attempting the Lunar Events.

title: Post-Golem → Moon Lord Ranged
summary: Shroomite Armor holds strong; Celestial Event drops like the Phantasm push ranged toward Moon Lord readiness.

weapons.label: Phantasm — Frost Moon wave 15 drop, top-tier multi-arrow bow
S.D.M.G. — Pumpkin Moon wave 15 drop, extremely high dps automatic weapon
Chlorophyte Shotbow — still viable if event weapons aren't farmed yet

accessories.label: Ankh Shield — immunity to nearly every debuff + no knockback
Destroyer Emblem — flat damage boost
Magic Quiver — arrow damage/velocity, ammo conservation
Frostspark Boots — movement speed + flight
Charm of Myths — faster potion cooldown + healing potion boost

notes: Full loadout: Shroomite Armor + S.D.M.G. or Phantasm, plus the 5 accessories above. Both goal weapons come from the Pumpkin Moon and Frost Moon events — farm these before the Lunar Events since Moon Lord's phases favor exactly this kind of sustained high dps.

title: Post-Golem → Moon Lord Mage
summary: Nebula Armor's damage/mana-focused set bonus and Last Prism-tier weapons push mage toward Moon Lord.

weapons.label: Razorblade Typhoon — Pumpkin Moon wave 15 drop, boomerang-style magic weapon
Blizzard Staff — Frost Moon wave 15 drop, strong homing summon-hybrid
Laser Machinegun — Frost Moon drop, rapid-fire beam weapon

accessories.label: Ankh Shield — immunity to nearly every debuff + no knockback
Sorcerer Emblem — flat magic damage boost
Mana Flower — auto-drinks mana potions, +magic damage
Frostspark Boots — movement speed + flight
Charm of Myths — faster potion cooldown + healing potion boost

notes: Full loadout: Nebula Armor (from Fragments dropped by the Celestial Pillars) + Razorblade Typhoon or Blizzard Staff, plus the 5 accessories above. Nebula's set bonus passively buffs all stats the longer you fight, making it strong for sustained boss fights like Moon Lord's long phases.

title: Post-Golem → Moon Lord Summoner
summary: Stardust Armor's minion-spawning set bonus is a massive summoner power spike heading into Moon Lord.

weapons.label: Stardust Dragon Staff — Martian Madness drop, top-tier piercing dragon minion
Xeno Staff — Martian Madness drop, strong UFO minion
Deadly Sphere Staff — Pumpkin Moon wave 15 drop

accessories.label: Ankh Shield — immunity to nearly every debuff + no knockback
Summoner Emblem — flat summon damage boost
Necromantic Scroll — extra summon damage
Papyrus Scarab — extra minion slot and summon damage
Charm of Myths — faster potion cooldown + healing potion boost

notes: Full loadout: Stardust Armor (its set bonus spawns an extra Stardust Cell minion automatically) + Stardust Dragon Staff, plus the 5 accessories above. Farm the Martian Madness event (triggered randomly in space after Golem) for the Dragon Staff and Xeno Staff before attempting Moon Lord.

title: Post-Golem → Moon Lord Rogue
summary: Celestial Event drops finally give Rogue real endgame-tier thrown weapons ahead of Moon Lord.

weapons.label: Chain Knife — Pumpkin Moon drop, retrievable high-damage thrown weapon
Flying Dragon — Frost Moon wave 15 drop, strong melee-adjacent thrown sword projectile
The Eventide — Martian Madness drop, splitting boomerang-style thrown weapon

accessories.label: Ankh Shield — immunity to nearly every debuff + no knockback
Shark Tooth Necklace — flat damage boost
Frostspark Boots — movement speed + flight
Charm of Myths — faster potion cooldown + healing potion boost

notes: Full loadout: Stalker's Armor + Chain Knife or The Eventide, plus the accessories above. Farm the Pumpkin Moon, Frost Moon, and Martian Madness events for thrown-weapon drops — this is the stage where Rogue finally catches up to other classes in raw weapon power, even without a Solar/Nebula/Stardust-tier armor equivalent.

title: Post-Moon Lord Melee
summary: Endgame content: Zenith is the ultimate melee weapon, paired with the strongest post-ML armor and full damage-stacking accessories.

weapons.label: Zenith — combine 12 endgame swords at an Ancient Manipulator, the final melee weapon
Terrarian — Empress of Light drop, top-tier yoyo alternative
Influx Waver — Duke Fishron drop, strong piercing sword projectile

armor.label: Solar Flare Helmet (or Fire Gauntlet variant loadouts, boss-dependent)

accessories.label: Ankh Shield — immunity to nearly every debuff + no knockback
Avenger Emblem — flat damage boost, upgraded from Destroyer Emblem
Fire Gauntlet — melee speed, knockback, and extra fire damage
Frostspark Boots — movement speed + flight
Celestial Shell — combined day/night stat buffs + regen

notes: Full loadout: Solar Flare Armor + Zenith, plus the 5 accessories above. Zenith requires 12 different swords collected across the entire game (Terra Blade, Enchanted Sword, Starfury, Meowmere, Influx Waver, Seedler, True Excalibur, Star Wrath, The Horseman's Blade, Volcano, Beam Sword/Copper Shortsword, and Christmas Tree Sword), so this build is the natural finale after farming Duke Fishron, Empress of Light, and the Old One's Army event.

title: Post-Moon Lord Ranged
summary: Endgame ranged weapons from Duke Fishron and Empress of Light headline the strongest gun/bow loadout in the game.

weapons.label: Tsunami — Duke Fishron drop, top-tier arrow-spam bow
Vortex Beater — hybrid grenade launcher/rifle, huge post-ML dps
Celebration Mk2 — Empress of Light drop, powerful firework launcher

armor.label: Shroomite Headgear (still best-in-slot for pure ranged dps)

accessories.label: Ankh Shield — immunity to nearly every debuff + no knockback
Avenger Emblem — flat damage boost
Magic Quiver — arrow damage/velocity, ammo conservation
Frostspark Boots — movement speed + flight
Celestial Shell — combined day/night stat buffs + regen

notes: Full loadout: Shroomite Armor + Tsunami or Vortex Beater, plus the 5 accessories above. Farm Duke Fishron (fishing with Truffle Worm bait during a Blood Moon or via Fishron Wings-triggering conditions) and Empress of Light (Hallow, night, high mobility fight) for the best endgame weapon drops.

title: Post-Moon Lord Mage
summary: The Last Prism is widely considered the single highest dps weapon in the game, capping off the mage progression.

weapons.label: Last Prism — Moon Lord drop, the single highest-dps weapon in vanilla Terraria
Nebula Blaze — Empress of Light drop, strong homing magic missiles
Sagittarius — Duke Fishron drop, magic bow hybrid

accessories.label: Ankh Shield — immunity to nearly every debuff + no knockback
Avenger Emblem — flat damage boost
Mana Flower — auto-drinks mana potions, +magic damage
Frostspark Boots — movement speed + flight
Celestial Shell — combined day/night stat buffs + regen

notes: Full loadout: Nebula Armor + Last Prism, plus the 5 accessories above. The Last Prism's beam requires standing still and facing the target, so pair it with Nebula's tanky sustain and high mana regen. Note Last Prism has a very low drop rate from Moon Lord — expect to farm multiple kills.

title: Post-Moon Lord Summoner
summary: Stardust Armor plus the Stardust Dragon Staff and Empress-tier whips is the strongest summoner loadout in the game.

weapons.label: Stardust Dragon Staff — still the best minion post-ML
Durendal — Empress of Light drop, top-tier summon whip
Kaleidoscope — Empress of Light drop, strong summon whip alternative

accessories.label: Ankh Shield — immunity to nearly every debuff + no knockback
Avenger Emblem — flat damage boost
Papyrus Scarab — extra minion slot and summon damage
Necromantic Scroll — extra summon damage
Celestial Shell — combined day/night stat buffs + regen

notes: Full loadout: Stardust Armor + Stardust Dragon Staff + a summon whip (Durendal/Kaleidoscope) to direct minion focus fire, plus the 5 accessories above. Whips became core to endgame summoner play since they boost and redirect minion damage without taking a weapon slot away from your dragon.

title: Post-Moon Lord Rogue
summary: Endgame thrown weapons from Duke Fishron and Empress of Light finally give Rogue a true best-in-slot loadout.

weapons.label: The Devil's Finger — Empress of Light drop, homing bat-projectile thrown weapon
Shrimpy Truffle — Duke Fishron drop, bouncing high-damage thrown weapon
Flying Dragon — still relevant, strong melee-adjacent thrown sword

armor.label: Stalker's Helm (no post-ML rogue-specific set exists; this remains best-in-slot)

accessories.label: Ankh Shield — immunity to nearly every debuff + no knockback
Avenger Emblem — flat damage boost
Shark Tooth Necklace — flat damage boost
Frostspark Boots — movement speed + flight
Celestial Shell — combined day/night stat buffs + regen

notes: Full loadout: Stalker's Armor + Shrimpy Truffle or The Devil's Finger, plus the 5 accessories above. Rogue never gets a dedicated post-Moon-Lord armor set in vanilla, so Stalker's Armor with stacked flat-damage accessories (Avenger Emblem, Shark Tooth Necklace) remains the practical ceiling for the class.

title: Pre-Hardmode Melee
summary: Cheap, craftable gear that clears the pre-Hardmode bosses without any farming detours.

Fiery Greatsword — craft from a Demon/Crimson Altar drop, big early upgrade
War Axe of the Night — Eye of Cthulhu drop, reliable guaranteed-ish boss weapon

accessories.label: Obsidian Shield — craft from Obsidian + Shackle, no knockback + fire immunity
Hermes Boots — buy from the Traveling Merchant, movement speed
Band of Regeneration — craft from Star, Band of Starpower is a cheap intermediate
Cloud in a Bottle — chest/enemy drop, extra jump

Everything here comes from crafting or guaranteed-ish boss/event drops — no Golden Chest or Lock Box farming required. Buy Hermes Boots from the Traveling Merchant when he's in town.

Everything is buyable from Arms Dealer or craftable — no Sky Crate fishing required. Stock up on Musket Balls (cheap from the Merchant) before the Wall of Flesh.

Craft each ore tier's armor and weapons as you go rather than skipping straight ahead.
